diagnosis: The healthcare insurance claim endpoint fetches a claim by claim_id and serializes a nested Pydantic dataclass containing patient SSN and psychiatric notes. The handler lacks an authorization check to confirm whether current_user is the patient or assigned claims adjuster, exposing Protected Health Information (PHI).
exploit_request:
GET /claims/CLM-2026-9012 HTTP/1.1
Host: health.insurance-portal.org
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_patient_token>
